steps.why: The setup panel asks for file access before it downloads the game data to /sdcard/RVGL.

steps.text: Open RVGL VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If the setup panel asks for file access, press Allow file access, switch it on and press Done. Then press Download and install; it needs Wi-Fi and takes a minute or two.

notes: The app downloads the free game data (about 225 MB, 500 MB on the headset) itself. Existing RVGL data in /sdcard/RVGL is reused. Releases also carry a .apk.sha256; the pattern skips it. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
